# Emphasis and links

Run the server with **one** command and *never* restart it by hand.

Open the [dashboard](https://example.com/dash) in your browser, or read the [**full** guide](https://example.com/guide).

Old flags are ~~deprecated~~ and the `--fast` flag replaces them; see https://example.com/flags for details.

A __strong__ word, an _italic_ word, and a snake_case_name that stays as it is.

- **Note:** keep `config.yml` next to the binary.
